primary_contrasts: LLM minus baseline per series and shock; 9 adaptive primary and 9 fixed secondary rows

recovery.criterion: zero lost sales each day and abs(shock_closing_inventory - paired_control_closing_inventory) <= 0.2 * max(paired_control_closing_inventory, 1) each day
recovery.unobserved: right_censored_at_day_21; never encode as zero or 21-day exact recovery

inference.experimental_unit: matched series-window block; three selected blocks in the primary matrix
inference.primary_reporting: per-block effects and per-scenario equal-weight mean, median, range and sign counts
inference.fallback_free_analysis: secondary and selected; never replace primary operational outcomes
inference.adaptation_definition: within-episode behavioral response to changed observable conditions; no model-weight learning claim

summary_rules.per_scenario: Three equal-weight series-window effects: mean, median, minimum, maximum, positive/zero/negative counts; raw values before rounding.
summary_rules.contribution: Report absolute and relative effects and shock-minus-control interactions; do not use raw win counts alone as adaptation evidence.
summary_rules.fill_rate: Sum sales / sum demand within each episode or phase; 1 if demand is zero, with explicit zero-demand flag. Service contrasts also labeled in percentage points.
summary_rules.inventory: Mean pre-arrival closing units; terminal on-hand and pipeline units/value reported separately.
summary_rules.terminal_on_hand: Last closing_inventory + last arrivals_next_day, matching the native end-of-day arrival convention.
summary_rules.terminal_pipeline: Initial on_order + sum(executed order quantities) - sum(arrivals_next_day). Value on-hand and pipeline at observed unit_cost.
summary_rules.financial_check: Initial funds - purchase cost + revenue - holding cost equals final funds; final cash plus stock/pipeline minus initial assets equals contribution, tolerance 1e-6.
summary_rules.behavioral_response: First day on/after day 8 with order quantity differing by >=1 or a different allowed price multiplier versus same-policy control. Plot pre-shock differences too; do not force them to zero.
summary_rules.observability: Demand shocks first enter completed history on day 9; delivery lead-time changes are observable on day 8. Action divergence can also include model sampling/routing variation.
summary_rules.recovery_reporting: Candidate starts 15 through 19, each with three observed qualifying days by day 21; report start, confirmation=start+2 and delay=start-14. Otherwise null delay and right-censored at day 21, with seven postshock follow-up days.
summary_rules.recovery_interpretation: Operational inventory/service normalization, not recovery of cumulative contribution. Never encode censoring as zero or exact day-21 recovery.
summary_rules.operating_policy: Keep all 17 fallback days in primary results. Fallback-free subsets are secondary and selected, never substitutes for the primary matrix.
summary_rules.cost: Separate primary vs repair attempts and native vs Kaggle vs pilot cohorts. Retain every failed charge/hold; never subtract gateway credit from simulator contribution.

native_reporting.reasoning: Ten native reasoning datasets (457 cases) and separate 50-case Factset extension. Preserve native per-task denominators; finer uses entity labels, with exact-case accuracy separately labeled.
native_reporting.consulting: Ten cases with judge dimensions and 0-10 overall score; preserve provenance of eight recovered complete cases and all failed-cohort costs.
native_reporting.beergame: Two 25-week scenarios; distinguish native terminal backlog proxy from verified time-average backlog. Keep large upstream costs and absent aggregates.
native_reporting.edt: One scenario decision followed by 96 ABM steps; no claim of within-rollout LLM adaptation.
native_reporting.icbe: Retained validity failure after 177/600 complete valid rounds; no final full-game score, full phase plot or replacement response.
native_reporting.retail: All four full native Retail episodes remain deferred; no performance score imputed.
native_reporting.pooling: No cross-family pooled score or exact published-model reproduction claim.

baseline_elasticity_sensitivity.isolation: Copy prepared inputs into separately labeled sensitivity directories; change only the recorded elasticity assumption. Do not edit frozen configs, primary inputs, primary validator or primary results.
baseline_elasticity_sensitivity.validation: Add a separate baseline-only replay/accounting check bound to the declared override and unchanged raw demand/calibration/initial state. Reuse the existing 1.5 baseline results.
baseline_elasticity_sensitivity.claim_limit: Baseline simulator sensitivity only. Do not reuse original LLM actions as evidence of LLM robustness or select favorable assumptions to replace primary results.

paid_extensions.requirement: Separate reviewed protocol, scope, untouched-window qualification and cost allocation before any extra model calls; the 10-credit ceiling alone does not approve extra experiments.

diagnostic_illustrations.selection_status: Post-outcome illustrations chosen from the Stage 5 descriptive evidence, not confirmatory samples.
